raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

- Add `check_weights(action="raw_checksum", names=[...])` so a P2P sender can verify the exact tensor bytes received before post-load transformations.
- Return SHA256 checksums for the requested named parameters through the existing runner selector and checksum response structure.
- Existing actions retain their behavior; the new work runs only when callers request `raw_checksum`.

## Evidence that this path runs

- **Completed integration CI:** [Miles run 39113558558, attempt 2](https://github.com/radixark/miles/actions/runs/39113558558/attempts/2) passed with `run-ci-image + run-ci-ft-short` on Miles `0ec247979e324343471db862ec4fd3bfa4909f9b`. All 8 CPU and 24 GPU execution jobs passed; skipped planning jobs and waived ROCm checks are not counted as execution passes.
- **Tested dependency:** the job log resolves SGLang to `08f83ed4ee55bcbb75547a60595ebcbac266f950`, which contains this patch as `e206259ad55a9461e2499d1e14be72e55c36997f`.
- **Direct execution evidence:** the successful [H200 GPU job](https://github.com/radixark/miles/actions/runs/39113558558/job/117663947196) logs `[WeightChecker] handle action=raw_checksum allow_quant_error=False skip_tensor_list=None names=[...]` at `2026-10-18T13:02:02.7082908Z`. This is not merely evidence that the patched dependency was installed: the new action was actually invoked with tensor names during the run.
- **End-to-end check:** Miles computes sender checksums, calls this action, and compares the returned checksums. CI mode enables the transfer-checksum option by default. The successful run therefore provides integration evidence for the sender/request/receiver/verification path.
- **Patch equivalence:** this PR's `88c4c862d2536817c702d2a17b5182416895ff63` is a conflict-free rebase of the tested patch onto `sglang-miles` at `3306788a100e05f8d21bbdab08e4739f4cce2550`. The full binary patch is byte-for-byte identical: 4 files, +27/-1. No behavioral adaptation was added.

## Validation boundary

- These results support merging the previously exercised patch; they are not a claim that every model, runner selector, or error case has been tested.
- The exact new base plus this rebased commit has not rerun integration tests. SGLang pre-commit was also incomplete locally because PyYAML and Rust tooling were unavailable; that is not reported as a lint pass.
